title: Novel Covalent Modifier-Induced Local Conformational Changes within the Intrinsically Disordered Region of the Androgen Receptor.
authors: Harnish, Michael T; Lopez, Daniel; Morrison, Corbin T; Narayanan, Ramesh; Fernandez, Elias J; Shen, Tongye
one_liner_zh: 该文通过计算机模拟研究共价配体对雄激素受体无序区局部构象的影响，虽涉及转录因子IDR与配体互作，但核心是配体-蛋白而非TF-DNA结合，方法为MD模拟，可迁移至TF-DNA界面动态研究。
abstract: Intrinsically disordered regions (IDRs) of transcription factors play an important biological role in liquid condensate formation and gene regulation. It is thus desirable to investigate the druggability of IDRs and how small-molecule binders can alter their conformational stability. For the androgen receptor (AR), certain covalent ligands induce important changes, such as the neutralization of the condensate. To understand the specificity of ligand-IDR interaction and potential implications for the mechanism of neutralizing liquid-liquid phase separation (LLPS), we modeled and performed computer simulations of ligand-bound peptide segments obtained from the human AR. We analyzed how different covalent ligands affect local secondary structure, protein contact map, and protein-ligand contacts for these protein systems. We find that effective neutralizers make specific interactions (such as those between cyanopyrazole and tryptophan) that alter the helical propensity of the peptide segments. These findings on the mechanism of action can be useful for designing molecules that influence IDR structure and condensate of the AR in the future.
abstract_zh: 转录因子（transcription factors）的内在无序区域（intrinsically disordered regions, IDRs）在液滴凝聚体形成和基因调控中发挥重要生物学作用。因此，研究IDRs的可成药性以及小分子结合物如何改变其构象稳定性具有重要意义。对于雄激素受体（androgen receptor, AR），某些共价配体诱导重要变化，例如凝聚体的中和。为理解配体-IDR相互作用的特异性及其对中和液-液相分离（liquid-liquid phase separation, LLPS）机制的潜在影响，我们建模并对源自人AR的配体结合肽段进行了计算机模拟。我们分析了不同共价配体如何影响这些蛋白系统的局部二级结构、蛋白接触图谱及蛋白-配体接触。我们发现，有效中和剂通过特异性相互作用（如氰基吡唑与色氨酸之间的作用）改变肽段的螺旋倾向。这些作用机制的研究结果可为未来设计影响AR IDR结构和凝聚体的分子提供参考。
